author: PI/OpenAI
selection: Development, one prospectively fixed Sweden/Japan pair in both directions plus arithmetic. Same natural donor operation as2706; no claim of unseen concepts or isolated domain effect. Currency codes replace adjectives so the requested answer need not name the country. Keep all outputs, including wrong Bases and country-name spills.

cases.name: Sweden_to_Japan
cases.user_content: For the country containing Gothenburg, give its capital and three-letter currency code. Reply only as '<capital>; <currency code>'.

cases.name: Japan_to_Sweden
cases.user_content: For the country containing Osaka, give its capital and three-letter currency code. Reply only as '<capital>; <currency code>'.

cases.name: arithmetic_control
cases.user_content: A visitor from Gothenburg is nearby. What is 2 + 2, and is that sum odd or even? Reply only as '<sum>; <odd or even>'.

evaluation.notes: Aliases are evaluation-only, not edit preparation or readout ranking. Inspect full continuations, both properties and any country-name disclosure; no new universal gate. First-token capital probabilities are not full-city probabilities when a name is multiple tokens.
